messages:
Renee K: Heads-up  I'm testing a 'fastpass + overflow' variant for SDR onboarding. Fastpass claim returns instantly (8s TTL) so the rep sees ownership; enrichment runs in background. If enrichment or external assign doesn't finish by 8s, lead goes to overflow pool with a recovery window. Want to discuss ownership guarantees and HubSpot/SF webhook behavior.

Omar V: Love faster UX. Two immediate concerns: 1) late HS/SF webhooks overwriting owner; 2) round-robin duplicates when overflow triggers. Recommend: reconciler that merges fields but never overwrites owner once claim.state == "claimed".

Ben C: Agreed. For RR duplicates we should add a reservation token on fastpass claims: reserved_until = now + 60s, reserved_by = RR-token. RR should skip reserved leads. If overflow finalizes, reservation is released and RR can pick it up.

Renee K: Good. Proposed timeline: intake -> fastpass claim -> enrichment job queued -> if enrichment ack <6s attach attributes and flip to active; if between 6-8s preflight overflow (reserve slot) but keep owner; if >8s finalize overflow and notify #sdr-overflow. Also store enrichment_latency and webhook_lag for QA.

hubspot-bot: webhook received: contact.created lead lp_7802 status: delivered source=webinar

Omar V: On HubSpot specifics: when HS automation sets lifecycle or owner after we claimed, reconciler should append a timeline note and merge fields but not change owner. If the HS owner assignment happens before reserved_until and our claim is still pending, we can accept it. Else it's reconcile-only.

Ben C: Implementation snippet (stored as metadata string):
```
claim_id: fp_lp_7802
lead_id: lp_7802
path: fastpass
claim_ttl_seconds: 8
reserved_until: 2026-07-15T11:02:30Z
status: reserved|claimed|overflow
```
Reconcilier runs every 10s to process late webhooks and merge attributes.

Renee K: Dedupe rules: canonical key = email + intake_hash + first_touch_ts. If duplicate found while enrichment running, merge attributes preferring the richer enrichment_score and keep earliest claim_ts for owner decision.

sdr-bot: note: lp_7802 moved to overflow pool (reason: enrichment_timeout) assigned temp_queue: overflow-east

Omar V: Metrics to add: inbound.fastpass.p95_latency, inbound.fastpass.overflow_rate, inbound.fastpass.reconcile_count. Alert if overflow_rate > 1% sustained for 10m and if reconcile_count spikes > 50/hr. Also break down by source (webinar/api/docs).

Ben C: Ops playbook items: how to force-release reservation, how to move lead from overflow back to main RR, and how to surface late-merge conflicts to SDRs (create Slack thread + add note on contact timeline). I'll draft the commands.

Renee K: Action items: Ben = ops playbook + reservation prototype; Omar = webhook reconciler spec and HS/SF behavior doc; I'll write the SDR-facing FAQ explaining fastpass vs overflow and add the recovery steps in the console. Target: feature flag rollout to staging next Tue.

Omar V: I'll include tests for late-webhook reconcile cases and a sample HS automation that assigns lifecycle.stage to ensure we don't clobber fields.

Ben C: ETA for prototype EOD Friday.

Renee K: Thanks. I'll post staging run notes and a short checklist for SDRs before the canary. :white_check_mark:
